description: ImmutableExpressionResolver is a final class implementing ExpressionResolver that provides logic to resolve placeholders and function expressions within string templates, supporting pipeline stages and referencing other resolvers.

classes.name: ImmutableExpressionResolver
classes.description: Immutable implementation of ExpressionResolver handling placeholder resolution and pipeline expression parsing.

methods.name: resolveAsPipelineElement
methods.description: Resolves a placeholder expression into a pipeline element, handling pipeline stages and initial placeholder or function.

methods.name: findPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Finds the appropriate PlaceholderResolver for a given placeholder in the pipeline.

methods.name: resolveSinglePlaceholder
methods.description: Resolves a single placeholder using the associated resolver; throws exception if not found.

methods.name: getPipelineStagesExpressions
methods.description: Splits a placeholder expression into individual pipeline stages, validates pattern, and limits complexity.

methods.name: getFirstExpressionInPipe
methods.description: Retrieves the first expression from pipeline stages.

methods.name: getPipelineFromExpressions
methods.description: Constructs a Pipeline object from pipeline stage expressions, skipping a specified number of stages.

methods.name: getPlaceholderPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the prefix of a placeholder before the separator.
